docs.text:
Sarkar’s short account of Hindu mathematics, astronomy, medicine and physics, claiming for the Hindus a place in the growth of exact science (London, 1918). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in Cornell University Library; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Hindu achievements in exact science; a study in the history of scientific development · Sarkar, Benoy Kumar, 1887-1949 · 1918, 106 scanned pages. Published 1918; Benoy Kumar Sarkar died 1949; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page is the machine-read (OCR) text of the scan, lightly cleaned; the scan of every page is one button away. The item on the Internet Archive (opened only if you click it).
